'''Matt Ehrhart It Came From The Death Star''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matt Ehrhart]]
* '''Published:''' September 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Cloud City: Downtown Plaza]]
* '''Strategy:''' It Came From The Death Star
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor It Came From The Death Star Ehrha.txt |Download]]
